Title: Event Hubs available in North Central US

Body.Content:
Event Hubs is a highly scalable data ingress service that can intake millions of events per second so that you can process and analyze the massive amounts of data produced by your connected devices and applications.

With this addition, Event Hubs is now available in every public Azure region in the world.
